body:
@easy90rider I think I understand the issue now. Partially at least. The reader gets the last chunk a bit smaller than it should be compared to the entire file size. I've removed some logic which could have trimmed the last chunk but I'm not overly confident. It seems to be the last couple of kb so this won't really be noticeable for a movie playback.

Try out the latest beta when you have the chance. It's likely those errors won't appear anymore. Please do share the result when you can.

Tip: it seems you have a fairly large library. 5GB of cache is a bit small. That's why you're already seeing deletions during scanning. The total size you gave won't even be enough to get through a full library scan.
If you're low on disk you can still go like this but since Plex scans most of the time you will also generate a bit of traffic on the cloud provider too.
